notes.title: Patch 1.3.2
notes.content:
[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
- Fixed an issue where the "Play Again" button at the end of a custom game would send players back to the main menu.
- Fixed another case where the end-match screen would stay open after restarting the match in a custom game.
- Fixed a case where the player's mouse cursor would be visible after a match restarts or is joined by a player (if this happens, press ESC twice to fix it!)

[h2]Lighting:[/h2]
- Shadows have been disabled on the local character.

[h2]INVESTIGATING:[/h2]
- Matchmaking appears to have some bugs still, and I am still collecting info as it's very difficult to test. Please report all matchmaking bugs via Discord with explanations if you can.

[i]Bugs can be reported on the official Discord here:[/i]
[i][url=https://discord.gg/cztgQZt3]Discord link[/url][/i]

notes.title: 1.3.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
[h2]Matchmaking:[/h2]
- Fixed an issue causing 2v2 quickplay to be stuck on Searching for players: 4/4.

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
[h2]Matchmaking[/h2]
- There are now 2 options for Quickplay matchmaking: 2v2 and 3v3. (thanks Oreo for the suggestion!)

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
- Another attempted fix for being stuck in the Lobby phase of a server browser match

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[h2]Performance Improvements:[/h2]
Performance improvements:
- Optimised a team check that used to run every second that was causing frame drops for some users.
- General performance improvements game-wide. Low settings will make the game look worse than before, but improving performance significantly.

[h2]Input:[/h2]
- Disabled mouse smoothing by default.

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
- Added a check to stop the end-match screen getting stuck after "Play Again" is selected by the host in custom match mode. (thanks WaDogKing!)
- Players that spawn during the Lobby phase should no longer be frozen until the match starts. (thanks DMRocks!)

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[h2]Bug fixes/small changes[/h2]
- The crowd cheer at the end of the match now correctly follows the Crowd volume slider.
- Fixed an issue where multiple instances of a player could show up on the scoreboard. [i](thanks IonImpulse!)[/i]
- The host will now start on Blue team instead of in spectator mode.
- At the end of a match, a new element has been added to automatically display the scoreboard and allow leaving the game (or playing again if you are the host).

[h3]KNOWN ISSUES:[/h3]
- Possible issues with the ball escaping the map (please report this with a video in Discord if possible!)
- Game log sometimes reports the wrong player leaving the server
- Performance issues on Fame [i](thanks DMRocks!)[/i]

notes.title: The game's out!
notes.content:
v1.0.1 Changes:
- Re-enabled the item shop from the inventory screen.

I hope you all enjoy the game!
If you encounter any issues, please report them in the Discord (or a review!):
https://discord.gg/6pDRpwFrUK
